title: add a divide() function to the calculator
description: src/calculator.js exports add/subtract/multiply but not divide. Add a divide(a, b) function that throws on b === 0. The acceptance test exercises both the happy path and the divide-by-zero case.

issue.title: calculator missing divide()
issue.body:
src/calculator.js needs a `divide(a, b)` export. It must:

- return a/b for non-zero b
- throw an Error with message containing 'divide by zero' when b === 0

See test.js for the exact acceptance criteria.
